people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: who hasn’t eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife,
translations.bsb: He does not eat at the mountain or look to the idols of the house of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife.
translations.kjv: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour's wife,
translations.asv: that hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbor's wife,
